tracks.name: pinning
tracks.description: Optimize the QSB pinning grinder: ECDSA public-key recovery + SHA-256 over candidates that vary a 75-byte tail of a ~10 KB preimage. Maximize verified candidate throughput on a single GPU.

tracks.name: subset
tracks.description: Optimize the QSB subset-selection grinder: ECDSA public-key recovery + SHA-256 over candidates that rebuild a ~1.7 KB section of a ~9.9 KB preimage (9 of 150 pushes omitted). Maximize verified candidate throughput on a single GPU.
